name: Heading Link Sync
changes: The Sponsor on GitHub button now opens the one-time payment tab of GitHub Sponsors.
tip: Leave a retyped heading or stop typing for 1.5 seconds to update its links.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Heading Link Sync is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to keep your links working.
